reader_title: McAllen requires conditional use approval in I-2
summary: The city lists data centers as a conditional use in its I-2 industrial district. No other district is marked for data centers in this table.
locator: February 9, 2026 code, Article 3.1 use table, printed p. 40

reader_title: One parking space per 1,000 square feet
summary: McAllen sets the parking minimum in the same table that lists its data center zoning requirements.
locator: Article 3.1 use table, printed p. 40, minimum parking ratios

thresholds.context: Minimum requirement on the data center row of the I-2 use table.

reader_title: County approval is required even for an in-house data center
summary: A data center within the county’s zoning jurisdiction needs a special use permit from the Board of Commissioners. This includes a center inside another business that serves only the owner, occupies at most 10% of its footprint and has no separate building.
evidence: via issuance of a special use permit

reader_title: Five acres for a data center; 20 for its power plant
summary: The county sets separate minimum lot sizes for the data center and for a data center power plant.
evidence: No data center shall be erected on any lot less than five acres

thresholds.context: Applies to a data center power plant.

reader_title: Keep buildings 1,000 feet from residences and residential lots
summary: The county applies this distance to data centers and their power plants. Other property lines and public road rights-of-way require at least 60 feet or 1.25 times the structure’s height, whichever is greater.
evidence: from all residentially zoned lots and existing residences

thresholds.context: To residentially zoned lots and existing residences.
Property lines and public road rights-of-way: the greater of 60 feet or 1.25 times structure height.

reader_title: An independent engineer must measure baseline sound
summary: Before construction or operation, the owner must commission readings at eight locations around the site and give the planning department the report within 30 days of completion.
evidence: performed by a third-party acoustic engineer

thresholds.context: Around the site boundary; existing baseline sound study.
From completion of the study to delivery to the planning department.

reader_title: Keep data center buildings 500 feet from homes
summary: The 500-foot distance is measured to a residential structure. The city also requires a 100-foot buffer around the site, with dense vegetation and measures that reduce noise.

thresholds.context: Data center building to residential structure.
Dense vegetation and sound abatement required.

reader_title: Hold two public meetings before applying
summary: The applicant must hold at least two meetings at least six months before filing for conditional use approval and notify all property owners within 500 feet. The application must include proof of the meetings and a list of owners contacted.

thresholds.context: Public meetings before the conditional use application.
Before filing the conditional use application.
Notify owners within this distance of the site.
